tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Create a secure checkout for the selected quote after the customer explicitly confirms the final price.

email.description: Email address for ride confirmation and receipts.

notes.description: Optional flight number or special request.

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true only after the customer explicitly confirms the displayed final price.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key for safely retrying the same checkout request.

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify whether a checkout has been paid before reporting the reservation as confirmed.

checkout_session_id.description: Stripe checkout session identifier returned by start_booking.
